Block_Structure.Trial_number: 96 trials (24 per condition: self-matching, self-mismatching, stranger-matching, stranger-mismatching)

Trial_Structure.Stimulus_order: Shape above fixation, label below fixation

exp1.detail: Raw trial-level data not available: the public OSF repository (osf.io/hbrus) contains only aggregated behavioral scores (SPE_score, demographics, head motion, self-construal scales for 348 participants), fMRI connectivity matrices and analysis code - no per-trial matching-task exports; the aggregate files carry no participant IDs. Per stage-4 criteria (complete Clean data with full documentation), *_raw.csv is exempted; the full OSF archive (2026-08-31 download) and the original subject-level source file (Zhang_2023_NeuroImage_Exp1_raw_Subject.csv, 347 participants, recovered 2026-08-31 from git history and archived in the input zone) are stored in the study *_Raw/ input zone. Clean contains 346 participants x 96 formal trials (6 blocks x 16) plus practice rows (Block=NA): 340 participants have usable trial data (subjects 142/211/385/413 no responses RT=0, 402 only 11/112 correct, 62 single placeholder NA row); subj_info lists 347 (= original subject source, 0-difference; subject 101 has demographics but no trial rows); paper analysis N=348 (380 recruited, 20 excluded for incomplete task/demographics, 12 for head motion). Demographics: subject file 174F/172M/1 blank (age 0-36, incl. age=0 for 389 and 36 for 90 as in source) vs paper 182F/166M (18-34) - the shared subject file and the paper analysis sample differ in composition (see Verifying_original_results_issues.md Issue 5). SPE replication: OSF SPE_score (n=348, mean 94.98, sd 70.72) matches Clean-computed stranger-match minus self-match RT on correct trials (mean 98.74, sd 71.85; author RT-filtering script not on OSF, no exact per-value alignment). Stimulus labels in the raw data are Chinese (ni/shengren).
